::: {.lead}
Baltimore Ravens finished 2025 at 8&ndash;9. The model grades them as a pretender: competent offence, poor defence. Records here tend to overstate the underlying team.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Pretender** &mdash; *Competent offence, poor defence. Records here tend to overstate the underlying team.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Functional Run Identity"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Competent** |
| Defence tier | **Poor** |
| Pass defence rank | **#23** |
| Rush defence rank | **#12** |
| Wins above / below model | **+0.1** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **L.Jackson** closed the season at **-0.035 EPA per dropback** and **0.8% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 18).

**Running back.** **D.Henry** led the backfield with **304 carries** at **0.023 EPA per rush** (5.1 YPC, 41.4% success). Blocking versus creation: **2.9** yards before contact, **2.3** after. Style: *Efficient creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **10.7 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **4.1 to 17.0**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
